sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor’s degree and generally 3.0 GPA. Pure track preparation: multivariable calculus, introductory
differential equations, linear algebra, and at least three advanced mathematics courses including abstract
algebra and real analysis in one and several variables, with 3.0 average. Mathematics major is not obligatory. A
UChicago mathematics degree is an eligible route subject to these details. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare unofficial transcripts, personal statement, three referees, passport and current visa copies; financial
documentation is also listed for international applicants. Submit the application early enough to trigger referee
invitations before the all-materials deadline, then pay through Nelnet. [s1] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No pre-application supervisor agreement is listed. Graduate queries: jennyr@buffalo.edu. The faculty list below
is grouped by research fit; supervision availability must be checked individually. [s1] [s7] [s8]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Letters automatically attach to the application and are checked off in the student-status portal. Requests can
be resent there. Incorrect referee email must be corrected by the department after submission because
applicants cannot edit submitted application information. [s3]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Admissions page updated May 7, 2026; recurring December 25 date. Funding amount explicitly covers
2026-27, not Fall 2027 entrants’ first academic year. [s1] [s4]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Central minima include TOEFL 79/revised 4, IELTS 6.5, PTE 55, Cambridge 185 and Duolingo 120. Official
agency reports must be within two years when International Admissions reviews the application. Departments
may assess English readiness beyond an exemption. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Automatic exemption for international students transferring from a U.S. college who completed or WILL
COMPLETE a degree, or attended at least two years, with GPA at least 2.0 and no more than a three-year
break. UChicago attendance fits if these conditions hold. Nonstandard exceptions require a departmental
petition, not a student petition. [s2]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Strongly recommended but not mandatory; institutional code 2925. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional. Mathematics department codes 0703, 0702 or 0701. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Mathematics publishes USD 23,690 for AY 2026-27 on a 10-month TA/RA/GA appointment plus full tuition
waiver for full-time funded PhD students. This is not a confirmed 2027-28 stipend; fee/insurance coverage and
guaranteed summer support are not stated on that page. [s4]
Years of support; Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
The department describes typically ten semesters of TA support, after which some students are adjunct
instructors. This is descriptive, not an unconditional five-year guarantee. First three years usually involve
recitations rather than sole responsibility for classes; teaching training and evaluation apply. [s4]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International students are explicitly eligible for Presidential Fellowships if qualified. Department supports
graduate TAs; individual assistantship immigration and language conditions still need confirmation. Schomburg
Fellowship requires U.S. citizenship or permanent residence, so an F-1-only applicant is ineligible. [s4]
Extra funding application; Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Presidential Fellowship is departmental nomination, not direct application: CAS advertises USD 10,000 top-up
renewable for up to three additional years while fully funded, full-time and in good standing. Central page
requires undergraduate GPA 3.40; CAS wording offers a confusing alternative GRE criterion. No separate
applicant essay/reference is public; ask the department. Schomburg is unavailable on F-1-only status. [s4] [s5]
[s6]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 75 nonrefundable. After submitting, pay online by credit card or ACH through Nelnet. [s1]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
The published department waiver route is restricted to U.S. citizens/current permanent residents: request in
portal after completing and uploading required materials. An F-1-only applicant does not meet that category;
no math-specific international waiver established. [s1]

UChicago mathematics degree is an eligible route subject to these details. [s1] [s2]

documentation is also listed for international applicants. Submit the application early enough to trigger referee
invitations before the all-materials deadline, then pay through Nelnet. [s1] [s3]

No pre-application supervisor agreement is listed. Graduate queries: jennyr@buffalo.edu. The faculty list below
is grouped by research fit; supervision availability must be checked individually. [s1] [s7] [s8]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Letters automatically attach to the application and are checked off in the student-status portal. Requests can
be resent there. Incorrect referee email must be corrected by the department after submission because
applicants cannot edit submitted application information. [s3]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Admissions page updated May 7, 2026; recurring December 25 date. Funding amount explicitly covers
2026-27, not Fall 2027 entrants’ first academic year. [s1] [s4]

documents [Standing rule]

English requirement [Standing rule]
Central minima include TOEFL 79/revised 4, IELTS 6.5, PTE 55, Cambridge 185 and Duolingo 120. Official
agency reports must be within two years when International Admissions reviews the application. Departments
may assess English readiness beyond an exemption. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Automatic exemption for international students transferring from a U.S. college who completed or WILL
COMPLETE a degree, or attended at least two years, with GPA at least 2.0 and no more than a three-year
break. UChicago attendance fits if these conditions hold. Nonstandard exceptions require a departmental
petition, not a student petition. [s2]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Strongly recommended but not mandatory; institutional code 2925. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional. Mathematics department codes 0703, 0702 or 0701. [s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload unofficial transcripts showing all coursework from every institution. Certified English records and proof
of conferral are required; international students are told to bring official final records on arrival. Domestic
three-weeks-before-start instructions should not silently be substituted for the international rule. [s1] [s2]

Number and type [Standing rule]
Three letters, normally professors or employers. No prescribed format; referees should use their institution’s
letterhead. [s1]

Presidential Fellowship is departmental nomination, not direct application: CAS advertises USD 10,000 top-up
renewable for up to three additional years while fully funded, full-time and in good standing. Central page
requires undergraduate GPA 3.40; CAS wording offers a confusing alternative GRE criterion. No separate
applicant essay/reference is public; ask the department. Schomburg is unavailable on F-1-only status. [s4] [s5]

Letters automatically attach to the application and are checked off in the student-status portal. Requests can

applicants cannot edit submitted application information. [s3]

Post-submission referee-contact corrections require the department. Public instructions do not establish
letter-content updates or cross-cycle reuse. [s3]

Mathematics publishes USD 23,690 for AY 2026-27 on a 10-month TA/RA/GA appointment plus full tuition

Years of support; Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
The department describes typically ten semesters of TA support, after which some students are adjunct
instructors. This is descriptive, not an unconditional five-year guarantee. First three years usually involve
recitations rather than sole responsibility for classes; teaching training and evaluation apply. [s4]

International students are explicitly eligible for Presidential Fellowships if qualified. Department supports
